remarks: Situated in the highly desirable Springville AIRE community, this beautiful 3 bedroom (plus den), 2.5 bath condo offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern style. Enjoy a private front porch, and an additional 2nd level balcony/porch. With 1,691 square feet of living space, several windows allow for an abundance of natural light and features an open-concept kitchen and living room ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is complete with quartz countertops, tile backsplash, a good sized island, stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry and a nearby laundry room.
